values.subject: GlowSpa prepaid-card service-performance and balance review report
values.body_text:
Review date: June 24, 2026. The subject was the GlowSpa prepaid beauty-care card and contracted store.
Compared with the contract, on-site records show reduced services and fewer appointment slots, indicating that service performance had deteriorated; the official card system balance differs from the membership contract and top-up receipt. Report HZC-PP-20260624-17 may support the ecommerce platform review of card-cancellation liability and balance; it does not replace the platform's final ruling.
